acceptance_criteria: Primary user story objective executes with valid inputs
Input sanitization and boundary constraints are enforced
Failure modes return actionable feedback without leaking system trace

Assumed standard enterprise database persistence with ACID compliance.
Assumed user session state is tracked via secure HTTP-only cookies or bearer JWT.

test_cases.title: Verify successful primary happy path execution
preconditions: System is online and user is in an active session
steps: 1. Navigate to the primary interaction interface.
2. Enter valid required data parameters into input fields.
test_cases.expected_result: Action completes successfully with status 200 OK. Confirmation message displayed and system state persists accurately.

test_cases.title: Validate system behavior when required fields are blank
test_data: All mandatory fields left blank / whitespace
steps: 3. Click or trigger the submission action.
4. Verify client and server validation responses.
test_cases.expected_result: Submission is blocked. Field-level inline validation banners trigger with clear error descriptions. No network mutation occurs.

test_cases.title: Verify boundary limits (max length string and single-character input)
steps: 1. Enter maximum allowed boundary length in target inputs.
2. Submit the form and verify data truncation handling.
3. Repeat with minimum valid input threshold.
4. Verify database persistence preserves exact boundary length.
test_cases.expected_result: System cleanly processes boundary values without UI overflow, server 500 crashes, or unintended character truncation.
